name: inv-4-one-evidence-minting-rule
description: Ledger facts are minted by one rule for both harnesses: only the shared tool-evidence recorder (engine/src/machine/tool-evidence-recorder.ts) may call extractEvidence(...) or append to the evidence ledger (.appendEvidence(...)). Claude Code's record-evidence hook and the Pi child recorder normalize their tool call into a HarnessToolCall and hand it to recordToolEvidence; a second minting path would let the two harnesses mint different facts from the same call (G4 slice 2, FR-031, SC-007).
fixHint: Build a HarnessToolCall with the harness adapter and call recordToolEvidence from engine/src/machine/tool-evidence-recorder.ts; never mint or append evidence directly.
